title: 再授连州至衡阳酬柳柳州赠别
author: 刘禹锡
prompt:

Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Tang-era clothing, architecture and objects if relevant. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: main subjects are confined to the TOP 25–30% of the tall sheet, softly dissolving into ivory mist by 33% height. Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 再授连州至衡阳酬柳柳州赠别 — 刘禹锡
去国十年同赴召，渡湘千里又分岐。
重临事异黄丞相，三黜名慙柳士师。
归目并随回鴈尽，愁肠正遇断猿时。
桂江东过连山下，相望长吟有所思。
visualReview: 两位中年友人立于湘江岸边，两只船分别待发，北归雁横过春山；是共同贬谪后的别离，没有夸张哭泣，主体上部、下方留白清净。
